import torch
from torch import nn
torch.manual_seed(42)
X = torch.randn(400, 2)
y = ((X[:, 0]**2 + X[:, 1]**2) > 1).float().unsqueeze(1)
train_x, test_x = X[:320], X[320:]
train_y, test_y = y[:320], y[320:]
model = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2, 16), nn.Tanh(), nn.Linear(16, 1))
opt = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.02)
for epoch in range(250):
    opt.zero_grad()
    loss = nn.functional.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(model(train_x), train_y)
    loss.backward(); opt.step()
with torch.no_grad():
    acc = ((model(test_x).sigmoid() > .5) == test_y.bool()).float().mean()
print('held-out accuracy:', acc.item())
torch.save(model.state_dict(), 'tiny-mlp.pt')
